name: zvideo_dd_open_video_mode
description: zVideo_dd::OpenVideoMode prepares the game window and opens the selected DirectDraw2 provider, returning a normalized success/failure flag.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo DirectDraw mode-open/source-cluster pass.
The PrepareWindowForMode failure branch is structurally present in the original wrapper but unreachable with the current accepted PrepareWindowForMode implementation, which always returns zero.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a7d20 validates the fastcall argument is unused, the call to zVideo_dd::PrepareWindowForMode, early return 1 if that call fails, the call to zVideo_dd::CreateDirectDraw2ForSelectedDevice, and MSVC bool normalization of that result to 0 or 1.

The native smoke runs OpenVideoMode through a real temporary Win32 window and patched DDRAW.dll!DirectDrawCreate, verifying return 0 plus DirectDraw2 global creation on provider success, and return 1 without query/release/global overwrite on DirectDrawCreate failure.
